claims.disproof_condition: 條件：三星電機寫出玻璃基板量產時程延後或停止開發，或宣布量產出貨。核查頻率：每半年。觸發後 48 小時：重讀 T-glass 布層的反向路徑。
claims.statement: Samsung Electro-Mechanics KPCA 2026 release: glass substrate technology applies glass as the core material to reduce warpage and secure signal and power characteristics while lowering layer count. Development-stage self-statement; the company's own November 2025 release put mass production with its joint venture after 2027 (not in this package).

source_doc.title: 三星電機 KPCA 2026 新聞稿（2026-09-10）：玻璃基板技術把玻璃當核心材料，減少翹曲、降低層數

sources.quote: Glass substrate technology applies glass as the core material to reduce warpage of the substrate and to secure signal characteristics and power efficiency while lowering the number of layers.
